event.title: Amnesty International Claims Russia's Foreign Recruitment is Human Trafficking
event.canonical_title: Amnesty International Claims Russia's Foreign Recruitment is Human Trafficking
event.summary: Amnesty International has released a report alleging that Russia's recruitment of foreign nationals to fight in Ukraine constitutes human trafficking. The report is based on interviews with prisoners of war who claim they were misled into signing military contracts with Russia.

revisions.title: Amnesty International Claims Russia's Recruitment of Foreigners Constitutes Human Trafficking
revisions.summary: Amnesty International has released a report alleging that Russia's recruitment of foreigners to fight in Ukraine amounts to human trafficking. The report includes testimonies from prisoners of war who claim they were misled into signing military contracts with the Russian army.
key_facts: Amnesty International claims Russia is illegally trafficking foreigners.
The report cites interviews with prisoners of war.
Recruitment practices are described as deceptive.

revisions.title: Amnesty International Reports Human Trafficking in Russia's Foreign Military Recruitment
revisions.summary: Amnesty International has released a report claiming that Russia's recruitment of foreigners to fight in Ukraine constitutes human trafficking. The report highlights testimonies from prisoners of war who were allegedly misled into signing contracts with the Russian military. The organization emphasizes that these practices violate international law.
key_facts: Amnesty International claims Russia's recruitment of foreigners amounts to human trafficking.
The report cites interviews with prisoners of war deceived into military contracts.
The recruitment practices are said to violate international law.
